summary: In the active ratio packet tau=det(P)!=0, the same-bank curvature becomes exactly tau^{-2}[[T_Z,-U],[-U,T_Y]] in the two partner coordinates ell=P^T V. Consequently full two-partner slicing freezes T_Y,T_Z,U. In original coordinates M=P^T Gamma^T and A_R=Gamma C Gamma^T; for every split with rank(M_J)=2, row(M_J)=row(Gamma_J^T), so A_R[I,J](I-Pi_J)=0 and the transverse cross-split Frobenius currency is identically zero. If rank(M_J)<2 the two-partner theorem cannot fire. The required successor is a one-partner-at-a-time trace that retains the moving U-slope before full slicing. This is a proof-interface obstruction, not a QFORM counterexample.
